Thanks for the quick pivot. I finished the manager loop and Rafael did the wrap; notes are in the shared debrief doc (I pasted a short summary below). Lina — you did a great job explaining tradeoffs and thought process given the condensed format.

Summary (short):
 - Product/system design: strong on prioritization and APIs; asked good scaling questions
 - Manager loop: clear ownership examples, good cross-functional communication
 - Fit/next steps: hiring team to sync and follow up by EOD Monday with outcome/next step.

Karthik — can you schedule a short internal debrief (15m) tomorrow morning for final decision? Rafael — please include suggested calibration notes if you have any edits.
